negative_reviews.author: Jake Streets
negative_reviews.text: Didn’t even eat we walked in the host just wandered off and multiple servers just ignored us didn’t even say anything polite like someone will be over in a moment when they messed with menus in the door way. When the host eventually wandered back he spoke to us I asked for a table for two he said okay walked round the other side held up a finger to say one minute and started to speak to the other people behind us! I mean that’s just plain rude so we turned around and left because if that’s how the service is it doesn’t matter how good the food it it’s not worth it. clearly a bit of TikTok hype goes to their heads

negative_reviews.author: Danial Rahman
negative_reviews.text:
The food at Maki & Ramen was great, although the overall experience could have been better.

I waited around 30 minutes for my food before being informed that there was an issue with their ordering system. I was quite hungry and was actually about to cancel my order when the food finally arrived.

Thankfully, the staff managed to resolve the issue on the spot and kindly offered complimentary drinks to make up for the delay, which I appreciated.

Despite the long wait, the food was delicious, and I appreciated how the staff handled the situation. Hopefully, the ordering system can be improved to avoid similar delays in the future. Would definitely give it another try!

negative_reviews.author: A KJ
negative_reviews.text: The food was really yummy, ordered the chicken laksa (halal). Aidan was very nice and helpful, he was the only one serving us during our time there. the rest of the staff were not the nicest.
